items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: So I go play with her. And in the audience later is Joe Glaser. So he saw me up there, and he said, 'There's that crazy son-of-a-bitch...'

ctx.x: 1947. And it was right after this that Joe Glaser decided to puts Pops in front of a small group. So he got Jack Teagarden and Barney Bigard... I don't know whether Zutty was doing that at this time or not.
When I saw the group, it was two years later. Big Sid was the drummer.
